identification: Pye (Pye Electronics Pty Ltd, Melbourne) model APJ, 1951, 5-valve dual-wave (broadcast plus 3 shortwave bands) valve mantel radio, large walnut-veneer cabinet with sloping sides, cream plastic surround, gold speaker cloth on left, six-bar slide-rule dial on right, three front knobs (volume, tone, tuning) and a band-change knob on the right side, Pye badge on the top. Identified by matching the cabinet and dial to the APJ picture on radiomuseum.org (Mingay's Price Service 1952-55) and the Silicon Chip Jan 2017 restoration article (side colour-coded band switch, 3 knobs, ~520mm wide). Hardboard back marked PHONO P.U. (pickup input), original twin-flex pickup lead hanging out, brown mains cord.
